name: Lilaa — Malayali Cuisine

result: 30% increase in table turns, 100% weekend reservation capacity.

name: Wings Luxury Beauty & Wellness
challenge: Create a luxurious, Instagram-ready salon that feels intimate yet spacious.
solution: Individual styling pods with LED mirrors, private pedicure suite, botanical murals.
result: 45% increase in repeat bookings, high client retention.

name: Wings Jewellery & Retail Showroom
challenge: Stand out in a busy luxury mall corridor with limited square footage.
solution: High-impact storefront featuring grand arched maroon grid glass windows, diamond-cut mirror wall.
result: 40% increase in corridor foot traffic, 32% conversion lift.

name: Corporate VIP Reception & Lounge
challenge: Design an executive reception and waiting lounge that conveys prestige, hospitality, and privacy.
solution: Sculptural cream armchairs, warm indirect LED ceiling troffers, organic cloud pendant chandeliers.
result: 98% executive visitor satisfaction, reinforced brand authority.

name: Serene Heights Luxury Villa
challenge: Integrate tropical plantation views with modern minimalist indoor luxury.
solution: Teak wood louvers, double-height ceiling voids, floor-to-ceiling glass paneling, and warm earth tones.
result: Bespoke sanctuary delivering high acoustic isolation and natural cooling.

name: Aura Dental & Wellness Clinic
challenge: Softment clinical sterile environment while retaining strict medical hygiene standard.
solution: Curved drywall partitions, soothing sage green accent walls, concealed equipment cabinetry.
result: Reduced patient stress index and improved ergonomic doctor workflow.

name: The Grand Horizon Boutique Hotel
challenge: Revamp a heritage hill station resort lobby and suites with boutique modern luxury.
solution: Heritage brass fixtures, custom rattan furniture, fireplace lounge, and ambient warm lighting.
result: Turnkey handover 2 weeks ahead of schedule with 95% occupancy rate.

name: Emerald Brew Artisan Coffee Lounge
challenge: Create a cozy acoustic coffee bar with high seating density and fast takeaway counter flow.
solution: Terrazzo espresso bar, acoustic wood ceiling bays, plush velvet banquettes.
result: High-vibe urban café that became a top Instagram check-in location.
